title: Geometric reducedness from the generic local rings
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $X$ a reduced scheme over $k$ [def-pc-reduced-scheme, def-weil-scheme-over-base]. Suppose that for every generic point $\xi$ [def-sc-generic-point] of every irreducible component of $X$ [def-weil-irreducible-components], and every field extension $L/k$ [def-pc-field-extension], the commutative ring $\mathcal O_{X,\xi}\otimes_k L$ is reduced (has no nonzero nilpotent element). Here $\mathcal O_{X,\xi}$ is the stalk of the structure sheaf at $\xi$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], namely the ring of germs of sections on open neighbourhoods of $\xi$, and the tensor product [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] has multiplication $(a\otimes l)(b\otimes m)=ab\otimes lm$. Then $X$ is geometrically reduced over $k$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]: $X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}L$ is reduced for every field extension $L/k$ (the fibre product is as in [def-pc-fibre-product]). No finiteness assumption on $X$ or its set of irreducible components is imposed.
